Files without a prefix are the depth-0 session: generation measured with the stream discarded on the board (96.9 s, generate-only.json), then streamed to the Mac over SSH (120.5 s, 121 s end to end; export.json, receive.json, stream-wall.json; the receiver checked every chunk against the token-signed manifest, 0 hash mismatches); on the Mac (M5 Max) the reference harness compared every limb with the spec (verify.txt: 11 + 8,402 limbs, 0 mismatches), assembled Lattigo keys, encrypted under the token’s public key and bootstrapped twice (e2e.json); the level-1 result went back to the board, which decrypted it over two primes, flooded it and released it under FHE decryption policy version 2 (decrypt.txt, e2e-check.json): 11.37 bits over 32,768 slots.
